description: Application-owned, zero-network handoff for one explicitly hash-selected Alaska Corporations Download CSV into an operation-scoped local-review release.
redirect_policy: No network requests, redirects, discovery, or source acquisition are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; inspect the terminal receipt and explicitly correct or replace the selected package.
checkpoint: A UUID operation durably records its start before copying a transient immutable input snapshot, invoking the existing Alaska builder, independently verifying and hash-binding the release, removing the raw snapshot, and writing a terminal receipt.
idempotency: The exact selection and CSV SHA-256 bind each operation. Re-running creates a distinct operation and no current pointer.
cancellation: Cooperative cancellation removes only operation-owned unpublished inputs and release before recording CANCELLED.
retention_profile: Successful privacy-minimized release evidence remains local-review-only; all transient copied raw source bytes are removed before a terminal receipt.
